title: OpenSearch/Elasticsearch Query DSL artifact (fixture expected/ shape)
description: One shared artifact per fixture for both OpenSearch and Elasticsearch, per OQ-7's resolution (one compiler, one shared 7.10-era DSL subset). Deliberately lightweight: it catches gross shape mistakes only. The semantic check is spec/semantics.md's 'Addendum — canonical OpenSearch/Elasticsearch rendering' (OSE-0..OSE-14), compiled and compared artifact-for-artifact since #1644. Note additionalProperties:false is load-bearing rather than hygiene — the absent '_source' member is what OSE-13 rests on (GRP-3 has no counterpart on this backend), and 'search_after' is admitted for #1622's benefit although nothing emits it today (OSE-10).

timeout.description: TL-2: the query time limit the host configured, as '<N>ms'; present only when a limit is set.
